row.title: branchsweep run needs a wall-clock budget: the daily sweep was cancelled at its 15 minute timeout
row.body: The gate runs after every merge, so a backlog of ~170 branches cannot finish in one 15 minute job; the timeout cancelled the run before the sweep branch was pushed, so every merge was lost and the backlog never shrank (runs of 2026-11-18 and 2026-11-19 cancelled, 2026-11-17 failed). apply() now stops merging after policy max_seconds (default 540) and records the rest as skipped with the reason, so a run always ends and its progress is kept.
